6.4.2.title: Risk Identification
6.4.2.control_objective: Identify sources of risk, areas of impact, events, and their causes and potential consequences across stakeholder groups.

6.4.3.title: Risk Analysis and Evaluation
6.4.3.control_objective: Evaluate risk likelihood (1 to 5) and impact (1 to 5) to compute quantitative severity indexes and prioritize treatment.

6.5.title: Risk Treatment
6.5.control_objective: Select and implement risk treatment plans, assign accountable owners, and monitor mitigation effectiveness against SLAs.

Principle 6.title: Specifies Suitable Objectives
Principle 6.control_objective: Specify project and stakeholder group health objectives with sufficient clarity to identify and assess risks.

Principle 7.title: Identifies and Analyzes Risk
Principle 7.control_objective: Identify risks to the achievement of objectives across the entity and analyze risks on a 5x5 Impact x Probability matrix.

Principle 8.title: Assesses Fraud and Financial Exposure Risk
Principle 8.control_objective: Consider potential for financial, commercial, or contractual compliance exposure in assessing risks.

Principle 9.title: Identifies and Analyzes Significant Change
Principle 9.control_objective: Identify and assess longitudinal changes in group sentiment and systemic portfolio risk velocity.

CC6.1.title: Logical and Physical Access Controls
CC6.1.control_objective: Enforce strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Firebase JWT validation, and quarantined external stakeholder onboarding.

CC7.1.title: System Operations and Vulnerability Monitoring
CC7.1.control_objective: Detect operational anomalies, delivery bottlenecks, and SLA threshold breaches across enterprise project workflows.

CC7.2.title: Anomaly Detection and Incident Escalation
CC7.2.control_objective: Monitor security and operational risk events and execute automated 24h, 48h, and 72h escalation response procedures.

HIPAA.standard_name: HIPAA Security and Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164)

164.308.title: Administrative Safeguards: Security Management Process
164.308.control_objective: Conduct accurate and thorough assessment of potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of protected information.

164.312.title: Technical Safeguards: Access Control and Integrity
164.312.control_objective: Implement technical policies and SHA-256 cryptographic integrity mechanisms to protect electronic records from improper alteration or destruction.

Article 5.title: Principles Relating to Processing: Data Minimization
Article 5.control_objective: Ensure personal data is adequate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary via batch Cloud DLP redaction and zero raw audio retention.

Article 17.title: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
Article 17.control_objective: Execute cascading erasure of operational meeting transcripts, embeddings, and risk attributions while recording an anonymized legal tombstone.

Article 25.title: Data Protection by Design and by Default
Article 25.control_objective: Enforce speaker-blind inference, ephemeral speaker account stripping upon Golden Record commit, and zero verbatim quotes in compliance exports.

Article 32.title: Security of Processing
Article 32.control_objective: Ensure ongoing confidentiality, integrity, and cryptographic auditability of processing systems and services.
